answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 31914 Country: India Title: Plz tell me can the names Allah like Rahman, Raheem, Rafi,Bari, etc. Question: Plz tell me can the names Allah like Rahman, Raheem, Rafi,Bari, etc. can to given to People. Do we have to call then Rahman or Ar-Rahman.etc. Its common in our society. Plz guide me. Answer ID: 31914 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 916/916/M=1432) Names that are exclusive with Almighty Allah i.e. Rahman, Rahim etc may be kept by suffixing Abd etc, i.e. Abdur Rahman, Abdur Rahim. It is not right to keep only Rahman or Rahim as name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
